note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-2 technical manual (English translation) of the BRDM-2. It holds the BRDM-2 as a wheeled entry. The manual publishes the identity (four-wheel amphibious armoured vehicle), the total (combat) weight, the overall and chassis dimensions, the ground clearance, the maximum road speed and range, the maximum engine power as horse power with no net basis, the engine swept volume, the mechanical transmission with four forward ratios and reverse, the final-drive ratio and the tyre size code with its regulated inflation range. Tyre width and tyre diameter resolve by the named size-code derivation. The entry emits a runtime row with one labelled absent field (grousers_state) so it is not runtime-ready. Every dimension is a published millimetre figure; the tyre pressure is converted from the published kgf/cm2 to kPa and the conversion is named in the state. The manual names no vehicle manufacturer, so the maker is unknown. No real source maps an AEE game class to the BRDM-2, so class_token is empty and no mapping is created.

operating_weight_kg.locator: Section 3 Technical Characteristics, printed page 9, row Total weight, kg - 7000 + 3%
operating_weight_kg.state: combat (total) weight as published 7,000 kg with a plus 3 percent tolerance; the manual publishes no separate kerb weight

length_mm.locator: Section 3, Overall dimensions, mm, printed page 9, row length - 5750

width_mm.locator: Section 3, Overall dimensions, mm, printed page 9, row width - 2350

height_mm.locator: Section 3, Height at full mass, mm, printed page 9, row the tower - 2310
height_mm.state: overall height over the turret at full mass, as published; the manual gives 1,945 mm on the roof

wheelbase_mm.locator: Section 3, printed page 9, row Wheelbase, mm - 3100

track_mm.locator: Section 3, Track, mm, printed page 9, row the front wheels - 1840
track_mm.state: front wheel track, as published; the manual gives the rear wheel track as 1,790 mm

ground_clearance_mm.locator: Section 3, printed page 9, row Clearance (at pres. Tire 2.8 kg/cm2), mm - 330
ground_clearance_mm.state: ground clearance at a tyre pressure of 2.8 kgf/cm2, as published

max_speed_kmh.locator: Section 3, Maximum speed, km/h, printed page 9, row on the highway - 95-100
max_speed_kmh.state: published as 95 to 100 km/h on the highway; 100 is the top of the published range

range_km.locator: Section 3, printed pages 9 and 10, row Cruising when driving on highway, km - 750
range_km.state: operating range on the highway, as published

published_power_hp.locator: Section 3, Power plant, printed page 10, row Max. power at 3200-3400 r/min, HP - 140
published_power_hp.state: maximum power 140 horse power at 3,200 to 3,400 rpm, four-stroke petrol V8; no net basis is stated

engine_displacement_l.locator: Section 3, Power plant, printed page 10, row Cylinder capacity, l - 5.53

transmission_type.locator: Section 3, Transmissiya, printed page 11, row Transmission - Mechanical, speed, power takeoff on the water-jet propulsion device
transmission_type.state: mechanical transmission with a transfer case and power takeoff, as published

gears.locator: Section 3, Transmission ratios, printed page 11, rows I drive 6.55, II transmission 3.09, III transmission 1.70, IV transfer 1.0
gears.state: four forward ratios with synchronisers on the third and fourth, as published; reverse ratio 7.77

final_drive.locator: Section 3, printed page 11, row The main gear axles - Hypoid, gear ratio 6.8

tyre_size_text.locator: Section 3, Chassis, printed page 12, row Tires - With adjustable pressure. The size of 13.00-18
tyre_size_text.state: tyre size code as published (imperial form; aspect 100 by definition); central tyre inflation regulated from 0.3 to 2.8 kg/cm2

tyre_pressure_kpa.locator: Section 3, Chassis, printed page 12, row Tire pressure - In the range from 0.3 to 2.8 kg/cm2
tyre_pressure_kpa.state: maximum regulated inflation 2.8 kgf/cm2, converted to 275 kPa by 1 kgf/cm2 = 98.0665 kPa; the range runs down to 0.3 kgf/cm2
